title: Verifiable Audit Trails for AI-Enabled Biological Design Tools: A Proposal for Verifiable Biodesign Logging
summary_en: The authors propose a tamper-evident audit-trail framework using cryptographic signing to establish a trustworthy chain of custody that can be used with any artificial intelligence–enabled biological design tool.
title_cn: Verifiable Audit Trails for AI-Enabled Biological Design Tools: A Proposal for Verifiable Biodesign Logging
